name: @substrat-run/control-plane
description: The shared control-plane deployment — ControlPlaneDO + the audited HTTP surface (first-flow.md §4, slice 1)

scripts.cf:deploy: node ../../tools/wrangler-config.mjs --app control-plane && node ../../tools/preflight-migrations.mjs --config wrangler.generated.jsonc && node ../../tools/preflight-pipelines.mjs --config wrangler.generated.jsonc && pnpm run build:console && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.generated.jsonc --x-provision=false
scripts.cf:deploy:test: node ../../tools/wrangler-config.mjs --app control-plane && node ../../tools/preflight-migrations.mjs --config wrangler.generated.jsonc --env test && node ../../tools/preflight-pipelines.mjs --config wrangler.generated.jsonc --env test && pnpm run build:console && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.generated.jsonc --env test --x-provision=false
scripts.dry-run: pnpm run build:console && node ../../tools/wrangler-config.mjs --app control-plane && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.generated.jsonc --dry-run --outdir dist-worker
